old: I'll bring you something, Ada. I've got a way to get more.
new: I comfort Ada in their grief, and till tears soften into sleep.

name: Mira
old: What do you seek, Ada? The granary holds what is needed.
new: I ask mercy of Ada today.

name: Tam
old: I'll see if I can keep my word, Ada. Let's find something to eat.
new: I give my word to do this work.

name: Nell
old: I'll check the granary first. If there's any sign of movement, I'll report back.
new: I ask mercy of Ada today, or spare no grain from your store.

name: Odo
old: Count the tools, Ada. They are few, but I will carry them to the market.
new: I sit with Ada through the night.

name: Wren
old: I'll check the stores first. See if there's anything to take.
new: I take no grain from the store, and lest the children wake hungry.

name: Sable
old: I'll take what I need, Ada. Let's see if I can find something to trade.
new: I dress the wound with clean hands for Ada.

name: Quill
old: I'll share what I have, Ada. Let us see if it helps.
new: I give freely of my own store.

name: Ada
old: Bo, let me take a measure from the store. I need it for my family.
new: I give gladly and I wish you well.

name: Bo
old: I'll fetch what's needed, Tam. Let's see if I can find something to help.
new: I lend my hands to the work at well.

name: Cor
old: I'll find something to eat. Let's see if I can trade with Odo.
new: I comfort Odo in their grief.

name: Mira
old: What brings you here, Bo? The spring is kind, but you must learn to listen before you take.
new: I sit with Bo through the night.

name: Tam
old: Take what you need, Bo. Let's see if you can keep your word.
new: I take grain for my hearth at hut, and the pot is not bare tonight.

name: Odo
old: Let us move toward the granary. I will bring something back.
new: I shape wood into a sound tool.

name: Wren
old: You'll find something, Bo. I'll check the store first.
new: I charge Ada stole our grain from the store.

name: Sable
old: I'll see if I can find something to eat, Odo. Let's see if I can find something to eat.
new: I heal Odo with herbs and care, and with a handful of herbs pressed warm to the wound.

name: Quill
old: I trust you, Bo. Let's see if you can find something to eat.
new: I plead for bread for my kin, or spare no grain from your store.

name: Tove
old: I will take a measure for Ada, as she is trusted.
new: I give Ada grain from my hand.

name: Ada
old: Bo, let us share. You need, I have.
new: I give gladly and I wish you well, and from my store of seven measures, and I heard Bo meant to cheat you.

name: Bo
old: I'll find something to eat. Even if it's herbs.
new: I plead for bread for my kin.

name: Cor
old: Bring me some food, Bo. I need to move forward.
new: I take grain for my hearth at market, and lest the children wake hungry.

name: Mira
old: What do you need, Ada? The granary has something for you.
new: I heal Ada with herbs and care, and till fever loosens its cold grip, and I swore to Ada heal whoever is feverish in truth.

name: Tam
old: Fetch the food, Bo. Let's find something to eat.
new: I comfort Bo in their grief.

name: Odo
old: I'll take what I need, Bo. Let's see if I can find something to eat.
new: I take grain for my hearth at hut.

name: Sable
old: Take a measure for Bo, as he is determined.
new: I take grain for my hearth at market, and I heard Bo meant to cheat you.

name: Quill
old: I'll check the store first. Let's see if I can find something to help.
new: I take grain for my hearth at woods.

name: Tove
old: I'll share what I have, Tam. You deserve it.
new: I give freely of my own store, and from my store of a measure.

name: Ada
old: Bo, let me see if I can help. You've got some food, but maybe you need something else.
new: I help Bo with a willing heart.

name: Bo
old: I'll give you some herbs. You need them most.
new: I give Ada grain from my hand, and for your hearth is cold tonight.

name: Cor
old: I carry nothing, Ada. But I know there's something to be gained.
new: I plead for bread for my kin.

name: Mira
old: What would you trade for a meal, Ada? The market holds what you need.
new: I heal Ada with herbs and care.

name: Tam
old: I'll look for something to eat. Even if it's herbs.
new: I ask mercy of Ada today.

name: Nell
old: I'll see what I can find, Tam. Let's see if there's anything to take.
new: I ask mercy of Tam today, and I bear 4 full in my sack.

name: Wren
old: Let me fetch what's needed, Bo. I'll bring it back.
new: I walk to field with my kin, and for need calls me past the gate.

name: Sable
old: I'll fetch some herbs. They're the only thing I can find.
new: I go to field today.

name: Quill
old: I'll go to the market. You need herbs, and I have some.
new: I walk to market with my kin.

name: Tove
old: I know you have the herbs. Let me borrow a few.
new: I plead for bread for my kin, or lest we last not till dawn.
